name: crazy-loading
description: 基于 Iconify 的数理主题 loading 图标集

scripts.build:icons: tsx scripts/generate-icons.ts && tsx scripts/sync-playground-meta.ts && tsx scripts/sync-icon-bodies.ts && tsx scripts/build.ts
scripts.check:effects: npm run check:duplicates && npm run check:clipping && npm run check:animation-loss && npm run check:fidelity
scripts.dev: npm run build:icons && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.build: npm run build:icons && npm run build -w playground
